name: How long does a custom trim and molding project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom trim and molding project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most single-room custom molding installations take one to two days to complete, including installation, caulking, and finish painting. Larger whole-home baseboard replacements or multi-piece crown molding projects across open-concept living rooms typically take three to five business days. The timeline changes based on whether existing trim must be pulled, whether walls need extensive drywall skim-coating or repairs behind old baseboards, and paint dry times between coats. Because owner Abraham Becerra leads on-site work directly, work steps move straight from carpentry cuts to prep and paint without multi-day delays between separate trade crews.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single room usually takes one to two days, while whole-home baseboards or multi-piece crown packages typically require three to five working days from carpentry to paint.
